rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being surprised or taken aback without necessarily implying extreme distress.

example.english: I was really shocked to hear them say that.
example.traditional: 聽到佢咁樣講，我真係驚訝。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou2 keoi5 gam2 joeng2 gong2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ging1 ngaa6

rows.note: Use this for a much stronger shock, especially when the speaker is also indignant or deeply disturbed.

example.english: This news left us deeply shocked.
example.jyutping: nei1 daan1 san1 man4 ling6 jan4 hou2 zan3 ging1

rows.note: Use this written-leaning adjective for being bewildered and taken aback, rather than simply surprised.

example.english: The result was completely different from the report, leaving us shocked and bewildered.
example.traditional: 結果同報告完全唔同，令人錯愕。
example.jyutping: git3 gwo2 tung4 bou3 gou3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4 ling6 jan4 co3 ngok6
